description: Visual-audit lineup tool for the LoP dinosaur pack. /showcase <family|all> spawns every species of a family in labeled rows (adult M, F, M, F, baby) with AI tasks stripped so they stand still for inspection. /showcase list shows families, /showcase clear removes all showcase animals. Short family nicknames work (tyranno, carchar, hadro, mosa, ...). Test worlds only.
name: Dino Showcase
